units.source_text: 如此看来，从前在宇治山庄时的哀愁，恐怕她已经忘记了。

en.t: Seen in this light, she had probably already forgotten the sorrows she once knew at the mountain villa in Uji.

units.source_text: 几个老年侍女说道：“小姐可回里面去了。

en.t: Several elderly gentlewomen said, "My lady, please go back inside.
It is unlucky to gaze at the moon.

units.source_text: 连果物也不吃一点儿，怎么办呢？

en.t: She will not eat even a little fruit; what are we to do?

units.source_text: 说出来难听：从前大小姐也不要吃东西，回想起来更觉不祥，真教人担心啊！”

en.t: It sounds dreadful to say it, but the elder young lady once refused food too, and remembering that makes this feel even more ominous. It truly worries me!"

units.source_text: 青年侍女们都叹息：“世间忧患真多啊！”

en.t: The younger gentlewomen all sighed, "There is so much grief and trouble in the world!"

units.source_text: 又相与议论：“啊呀，怎么这样对待夫人啊！

en.t: They also discussed it among themselves, saying, "Oh, how could he treat the lady this way!
Surely he will not simply abandon her like this.

units.source_text: 无论如何，从前那么深厚的爱情，难道会一笔勾销！”

en.t: In any case, could such deep love from the past really be wiped away all at once?"

units.source_text: 二女公子听了这些话，心里很难过，但她想：“现在听凭他怎么样，我抱定主意不说一句话。

en.t: The second young lady heard these words and felt deeply hurt, but she thought, "Whatever he does now, I am resolved not to say a single word.

units.source_text: 只是冷眼旁观，且看下文如何。”

en.t: I will only watch coldly from the side and see what happens next."

units.source_text: 大概她不欲让别人说长道短，想把这怨恨藏在自己一人心中吧？

en.t: Perhaps she did not want others gossiping, and meant to keep this resentment hidden within her own heart.

units.source_text: 知道前情的侍女互相告道：“可惜啊！

en.t: The gentlewomen who knew the earlier circumstances said to one another, "What a pity!

units.source_text: 薰中纳言大人如此深情厚意，当初何不嫁了他呢？”

en.t: Lord Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, has shown such deep feeling and kindness; why did she not marry him in the first place?"

units.source_text: 又说：“二小姐的命运真奇怪！”

en.t: They also said, "The second young lady's fate is truly strange!"
